title: Day 5 of making a cozy RTS where fluffy animals fight bugs, built with Claude, ChatGPT and Meshy (playable in browser + Android)
author: FluffyBugGames
selftext:
I grew up on red alert and AoE and always wanted a cozy version, so I’m making one. It’s called Scutterfluff: Turf Wars. You build a base, gather berries and wood, pump out units and go smack the other team, but everyone is fluffy.

Right now there are 6 clans. The animal side has hamster knights in acorn helmets, a frog pond gang, and a badger/moth night market crew. The bug side has bee hives, web weaver spiders and grub gardens. I’m working on 4 more. One is fish who walk around in fishbowls, and another is a crumb gang with 4 arms. Each clan has its own buildings, heroes with skills, and victory screens.

There’s also a day/night cycle with fireflies, and building windows light up at night. You’ll find little ponds and streams, and ruins and watchtowers you can capture around the map.

How I’m making it: Claude writes most of the code (it’s all in the browser with three.js), ChatGPT does the concept art, and Meshy turns the concepts into 3D models. Honestly the AI part is maybe half of it. I still fix a ton by hand: rigging, animating, painting faces, and removing random extra legs. The spiders kept coming out with 7 legs lol. Keeping every faction looking like the same game has been the hardest part.

It plays in the browser, and there’s an apk on the site if you’re on android. The app updates itself when I push changes.  
[https://scutterfluff.netlify.app](https://scutterfluff.netlify.app)

It’s still janky in spots, especially the AI opponents and balance. I’d love to hear what feels off, which clan you’d play, or what you’d want added. Multiplayer works too if you want to fight a friend.
